integrity: Exact 16-clock chronological permutation count; independent forward/backward recurrences; reproducible standalone standard-library verifier; external independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to homogeneous one-dimensional infinite-lattice random sequential covering by k-mers, k=2 through 6; no assertion for k >= 7. Generic finite-closure solvability and the approximate six-mer terminal dominance were previously known. Root uniqueness follows from explicit rational coefficient signs, not experimental data.
title: A unique temporal single-to-double occupation crossover in six-mer random sequential covering
